name: melt-mcp-server
description: Value-leak discovery and lead capture for Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible client — find where AI and software value is leaking out of your org, in dollars.
long_description: Melt exposes value-leak discovery directly to your agent: a free Stage-1 Sandbox estimator (melt_analyze_value_vectors), a calculator for quantifying an already-identified leak pattern in dollars/year (melt_estimate_annual_leak, matching Melt's real "Anatomy of a Scan" methodology), and a lead-capture handoff (melt_request_scan) for moving from a directional estimate to a real, log-verified finding. Zero configuration required — works immediately after install.

tools.name: melt_analyze_value_vectors
tools.description: Free Stage-1 Sandbox estimator — estimates where AI/software value is leaking in a department from headcount, labor cost, and dominant unstructured-input type. Also answers what earlier Melt materials called 'AI ROI leverage'.

tools.name: melt_estimate_annual_leak
tools.description: Quantifies an already-identified value-leak pattern in dollars/year, matching Melt's real scan methodology. Also covers what earlier materials called 'Feature Waste Dollar Amount'.

tools.name: melt_request_scan
tools.description: Lead-capture handoff — requests a real, log-verified Melt scan. Earlier materials called this a 'Thermal Scan'.
